items.text: Palo Alto Networks says attackers are exploiting the flaw under most websites against its firewalls' internet-exposed management pages. No victim named; some fixes due Oct 29-30.
UK web host 123 Reg says an 'AI-driven cyberattack' on Sept 18 read customers' names, phone numbers and account details. It suspects a China link.
Florida's attorney general sued AI image app A2E, saying it lets users 'nudify' non-consenting Floridians, including children.
Mayo Clinic's AI caught 73% of pancreatic cancers on CT scans radiologists had read as clear, against their 39%, an average of 475 days before diagnosis.
